main_text.p: tur: denique tributo annuo æquo ac tolerabili ex agro sibi hæredibusque suis pendendo cum civibus & agri incolis compararet, à quo nullæ possessiones aut res in agro sitæ immunes essent. Hæc concepta tum, & probata utrimque: sed in solennem formam redacta, & signata post annos demùm tres, cùm ager totus ab hoste quoque liberatus, & Principi subjectus essct. Is fuit annus à Christo nato M. D. XVIII, & mensis Februarij dies XVIII.

Deinde anno M. D. XXI inter Principem & Ordines agri in curiâ Groningana per legatos Geldricos senatumque urbanum sic convenit, ut ipsi in fide Principis essent, & hæredum ejus in perpetuum: Princeps & hæredes integra servarent ipsis privilegia, jura, instituta, leges, consuetudines, secundùm fœdera & pacta olim inter ipsos & civitatem inita. Sic in nomen Geldricum ab Ordinibus juratum, præmissâ conditione hac, non diutiùs validam vim juramenti hujus, quàm Geldrus tueri regionem posset. page.notes: Printed "esset" appears as "effet" in the scan; transcribed as printed. Catchword "giùs" is the first word of the next page and is at the lower right, below the last line. The word "longiùs" is split at the line end as "lon-" with the catchword completing it. Some italic and roman distinctions in the scan are small and were checked against the letterforms; the Roman numerals are copied as printed, with "xx" in lower case after "Iunii". Possible doubt over "XVIII" as printed (scan shows "xviii" with uneven spacing).
